summary.text: Lisa Wellman represents the 41st Legislative District, covering Mercer Island, Bellevue, Newcastle and parts of Issaquah, Sammamish and Renton, in the Washington State Senate. Her official biography says she was elected in 2016 and chairs the Early Learning & K-12 Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Wellman began her career as a public school teacher before becoming a systems analyst and programmer in the 1980s, according to her official biography.

It says she was recruited by Apple Computer to head commercial publishing for the company's U.S. markets and was later promoted to VP of Worldwide Publishing, Entertainment and New Media Markets, part of a 25-year career in technology and marketing.

In the Senate, the page says she also serves on the Energy, Environment & Technology and Ways and Means committees, as well as the Educational Opportunity Gap Oversight and Accountability Committee, the Mastery Based Learning Workgroup and the Work Integrated Learning Advisory Committee.
The page says she earned a B.A., summa cum laude, from Barat College of DePaul University, and that she lives on Mercer Island.
